title: Cylinder rescue, guide route and oriented delivery
summary: A short round-ended cylinder is rolling along a raised lane when the episode starts and will run off its end. Intercept it in the open-sided tray the Panda holds. Bring it to rest in the tray with its long axis along the world's y axis. Put it into a gently sloping guide channel near the channel's entry, and let it travel out past the far end without the tray touching it at that moment. Catch it again in the tray at the exit, aligned and settled. Finally, deliver it lying along y into a pocket that slides back and forth on a rail, where it must rest while the pocket is moving.
robot_setup: One Panda, base at (-0.55, 0, 0) facing +x (yaw 0). Its hand carries a 'receiver': a square tray 0.14 m x 0.14 m inside (2 x `tool_half`), walls 30 mm high and 5 mm thick, floor 5 mm thick. The wall on the tool frame's -x side is missing (open side). The tool frame is the centre of the floor's top surface, z up out of the tray. The tray is side-mounted: an L-shaped adapter bar runs from the hand to the top of the tray's -y wall. In the tool frame the hand's TCP is at (-0.12, -0.12, +0.04), so the tray sits 12 cm ahead of, 12 cm to the side of and 4 cm below the TCP. At the start the tray is level (identity orientation; open side facing world -x), centre at (0.21, -0.18, 0.13).
scene: The cylinder is orange and round-ended (a capsule), 76 mm long overall and 38 mm in diameter. At t = 0 it is rolling on its side, long axis across its direction of travel, along a raised, low-friction static lane (an orange slab on posts), and it rolls off the lane's open end within about the first second. Elsewhere, at a higher level, a static guide channel is mounted on posts. It is 0.09 m wide inside with 22 mm side walls, open at both ends, and slopes very slightly down from its entry end to its exit end. A short static wall stands just behind its entry end. A blue open box (the pocket: 0.15 m x 0.15 m inside, 0.06 m deep) is the moving link of a straight rail along the world's y axis. It is driven back and forth, slowly, by a force-limited drive. On its first outward stroke it runs into the side of the raised source lane and stays pressed against it until the drive reverses; it then moves back along the rail. The table top is the world's z = 0 plane.
scene_privileged: Cylinder: capsule of radius 0.019 m and half-length 0.019 m (overall 0.076 m), mass `object_mass` (0.035 kg), friction 0.35, restitution 0.05, long axis = its local x. At reset: centre (0.09 - `incoming_speed` x `preview`, -0.07 + dy, 0.1545) = (-0.225, -0.07 + dy, 0.1545), with dy ~ U(-0.004, 0.004) drawn at reset (first draw). The long axis is along world y, the velocity is (`incoming_speed`, 0, 0) = 0.35 m/s, and the angular velocity is (0, `incoming_speed`/0.019, 0) (rolling). It reaches the lane's +x end (x = 0.09) at about t = `preview` (0.9 s). Source lane `source_lane`: static slab 0.36 x 0.15 x 0.024 m centred at (-0.09, -0.07, 0.123), top z = 0.135, spanning x -0.27 to 0.09 and y -0.145 to 0.005, friction 0.1, with two posts. Guide `guide`: static channel whose floor's top runs from (-0.08, 0.18, 0.23) to (0.24, 0.18, 0.23 - `guide_drop`) = (0.24, 0.18, 0.225). The floor is 0.09 m wide and 10 mm thick, with side walls 8 mm thick and 22 mm tall centred at y = 0.18 +- 0.049, friction 0.16, on posts. Backstop `guide_entry_backstop`: static box 0.016 x 0.10 x 0.07 m centred at (-0.09, 0.18, 0.26). Pocket `pocket`: moving link of a prismatic fixture with rail origin (-0.05, -0.27, 0.07), axis +y, limits +-0.5 m. It is an open box (inner half 0.075, walls 0.06 m) whose floor's top surface is the link origin, mass 0.3 kg. At reset it is placed at q0 ~ U(-0.02, 0.02) (second draw) with velocity `fixture_speed`. It is then driven (PD, kp 80, kd 8, at most 8 N) to the target q0 + 0.20 sin((`fixture_speed`/0.20) t), with target velocity `fixture_speed` cos((`fixture_speed`/0.20) t) (amplitude 0.20 m, peak 0.04 m/s, period 31.4 s). Its +y wall (outer face at the pocket's centre + 0.08 m, top at z = 0.13) meets the source lane's -y face (y = -0.145, slab bottom at z = 0.111) at q of about 0.045 m. In an idle run (seed 0) the pocket stalled there with v = 0 from t of about 1.5 s to about 14.3 s, then followed its target back towards -y. Its speed exceeds 0.5 x `fixture_speed` = 0.02 m/s only before about 1.4 s and from about 14.3 s until about 20.9 s (|cos| > 0.5); the last fast stretch of the oscillation starts after the 25 s horizon. Receiver: `tool_half` 0.07, wall height 0.03, `tool_mass` 0.2 kg, `tool_friction` 0.3. Table friction `table_friction` (0.08). `target` = (-0.08, 0.18, 0.23) is the guide's entry point; `goal_axis` = (0, 1, 0).

phases.name: rolling_interception
phases.text: The cylinder is held by the tray and does not touch the source lane. 'Held' means: in contact with the tray within the last 25 ms; in the tray frame its centre has |x| and |y| < `tool_half` = 0.07 m; and its centre is between 0.013 m and 0.07 m above the tray floor.

phases.name: axial_alignment
phases.text: The cylinder is held (as above) and aligned, moving at less than 0.06 m/s relative to the tray (at its centre), for 0.3 s without interruption. Aligned means its long axis is within 0.2 rad of the world y axis, either way round: |y component of the axis| > cos 0.2.

phases.name: guide_rail_traverse
phases.text: During this phase the cylinder touches the guide while its centre is at world x < 0.02. Later, at a step when it does not touch the tray, its centre is at world x > 0.24, past the guide's exit end.

phases.name: exit_reception
phases.text: The cylinder is held by the tray (as above), aligned with world y within 0.2 rad, not touching the guide, and moving at less than 0.06 m/s relative to the tray, for 0.2 s without interruption.

phases.name: oriented_moving_delivery
phases.text: All of the following hold for 0.7 s without interruption. The cylinder touches the pocket and is not held by the tray. It lies inside the pocket: in the pocket's frame, for both x and y, |centre offset| + 0.019 + 0.019 x |axis component| < 0.075, i.e. the whole capsule is inside the inner walls. Its centre is more than 0.016 m above the pocket floor, and its top (centre height + 0.019 + 0.019 x |axis z component|) is below 0.063 m. Its long axis is within 0.2 rad of world y. The pocket moves faster than 0.5 x `fixture_speed` = 0.02 m/s. The cylinder moves at less than 0.06 m/s relative to the pocket. This completes the task.

task_failures: cylinder_left_route_or_receiver: from axial_alignment onwards (after the interception), the cylinder touches the table.
contact_rules: Only the tray may touch the cylinder, and the tray may touch nothing but the cylinder: not the source lane, guide, backstop, pocket or its rail, and not the table. No other part of the robot (fingers, hand, links, base) may touch anything.
world_goals_fixed: Required orientation: the cylinder's long axis along world y (either sign) within 0.2 rad. Guide test lines: world x = 0.02 (entry contact must occur at x below it) and world x = 0.24 (exit beyond it).
world_goals_seeded: `goal_target` is announced at reset. It is not seeded, but it is the guide's entry point, so it is privileged mode only. The axis goal (`goal_axis`) is not exported as an observation.
difficulty_note: The cylinder arrives rolling fast and leaves the lane almost immediately. It has to be stopped and turned to lie across its rolling direction in a tray with an open side. The guide has only a slight slope, and the final delivery must land in a pocket that is moving fast enough only during limited stretches of the episode.
standard_notes: The cylinder is already rolling at t = 0 and is off the lane within about one second. The pocket moves from t = 0, then stays stuck against the source lane for a long stretch before moving back. It moves fast enough for the last phase only for a few seconds after it comes free, and before its next turning point.
